decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan 11 Jun 2023;Existing and proposed site plan 07 dated Nov 2025;Existing ground, first & loft floor plans 04 dated Nov 2025;Existing and proposed elevations 06 dated Nov 2025;Proposed ground floor plan 01 dated Nov 2025;Proposed first floor plan 002a dated Nov 2025;Proposed loft plan 03 dated Nov 2025;SECTION A-A 05a dated Nov 2025;Cover Letter 20.12.2025;HMO Management Plan;Highway Safety Impact form;Email from Agent dated 04.01.2026 confirming max occupancy of 5 persons;Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the approved plans and supporting information, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than five residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the cycle parking indicated on drawing "PROPOSED SITE PLAN 07" prior to occupation; unless otherwise agreed; cycle parking should be provided in the front garden in compliance with the following criteria:i) Provision of a minimum of FIVE long stay cycle parking spaces one per HMO bedroom.ii) In an accessible location; the access route to each long stay store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates [excluding the store door] which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m.iii) Secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob.iv) Fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

Prior to first occupation, the refuse and recycling storage hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and thereafter maintained unless otherwise in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.
